biochemCommon.noCompany: No company to show. Ask Admin to give you a role in a company.
biochemCommon.noRight: You don't have the right for this. Ask Admin.
biochemCommon.readOnly: Read-only view: you can see production but not change it.

rules.licence.missing: Production entry is blocked: the licence for this kind of product is not recorded.
rules.licence.expired: Production entry is blocked: the licence has expired or is not active today.
rules.licence.no_number: Enter the licence number exactly as printed.
rules.licence.dates: Enter the date the licence is valid from (and an end date on or after it).
rules.prod.no_approved_formula: No approved formula is in force for this item on this date, so a batch can't open.
rules.prod.bulk_by_weight: Bulk materials are entered by weight (kg) only.
rules.prod.packaging_in_nos: Packaging is entered in Nos only.
rules.prod.pack_in_nos: The finished item must be counted in Nos (packs).
rules.prod.packaging_whole: Packaging is issued and counted in whole numbers.
rules.prod.not_in_formula: This material is not in the approved formula.
rules.prod.no_bulk_qty: Enter the bulk made, by weight (kg).
rules.prod.no_fill_weight: Set the fill weight on the formula or the net quantity on the item.
rules.prod.no_good_packs: Enter the good packs (and rejected packs) as whole numbers.
rules.prod.not_issued: This item was not issued to the batch.
rules.prod.recon_decrease: Scrapped and returned counts can only go up.
rules.prod.recon_mismatch: The batch does not reconcile, so it can't close. Recount on the batch first.
rules.prod.family_name: Enter the family code and name.
rules.formula.batch_size: Enter the batch size in kg.
rules.formula.no_bulk: Add at least one bulk material.
rules.formula.not_draft: Only a draft can be changed; make a new version.
rules.formula.qty: Every line needs a quantity above zero.
rules.formula.line_kind: Each line is bulk or packaging.
rules.formula.state: This step is not open for the version in its current state.
rules.formula.effective_overlap: Another approved version starts on or after this date; choose a later date.
rules.batch.state: This step is not open for the batch now.
rules.batch.has_issues: Material has already gone to this batch; finish or reject it instead.
rules.weighing.pending: A weighing still waits for the second-person check.
rules.qc.out_of_spec: Some results are outside the approved limits, so the sample can't pass.
rules.qc.no_test: The batch has no passed bulk test.
rules.qc.no_pass: The latest finished-goods test must be a pass before release.
rules.qc.sample_state: This sample already has its result.
rules.qc.result: The result is pass, fail or hold.
rules.asset.calibration_due: This instrument is due for calibration; calibrate it or pick another.
rules.asset.not_in_use: This machine is not in use.
rules.asset.code: Enter the asset code and name.
rules.asset.next_due: Enter the next calibration date (or set the interval on the asset).
rules.pack.name: Enter the pack name.
rules.pack.qty: Every item needs a quantity above zero.
rules.pack.gst_treatment: Choose the treatment agreed with the CA.
rules.pack.gst_treatment_unset: This pack can't be billed yet: Admin must set its GST treatment with the CA first.
rules.pack.inactive: This pack is not in use.
rules.rnd.code: Enter the trial code and title.
rules.rnd.day: Enter the stability day (0 or more).
rules.work.not_staff: This person has no role in this company.
rules.work.batch_started: The batch has started; a making duty on it stays on record.
rules.sod.own_formula: Someone else must approve a formula you wrote or submitted.
rules.sod.own_weighing: A second person must check the weighing you made.
rules.sod.self_release: You helped make this batch, so another QC person must decide on it.
rules.rights.reason_required: Give a reason of at least five characters.
rules.date.future: The date is in the future.
